environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL where AuthType is set to AWS_IAM. The function's resource-based policy specifies a Condition block requiring aws:PrincipalOrgID matching 'o-a1b2c3d4e5' and the principal must have lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission. The Function URL invoke mode is RESPONSE_STREAM. CloudWatch contributor insights are enabled on the function. The Lambda function has a provisioned concurrency setting of 2 with reserved concurrency of 5. X-Ray active tracing is enabled. The function timeout is 30 seconds with 512MB memory. Note: the read-only filesystem outside /tmp still applies (standard Lambda constraint), and the function uses the same Go binary with identical extraction logic.
